subject: [PATCH v3 09/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Serialize interrupt-time sdev block with hostdata teardown

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch serializes access to the hostdata of SCSI devices in the mpt3sas driver by introducing a new lock, ioc->block_lock. The lock is taken in two places: when walking the sdevs in _scsih_block_io_device() and when setting or clearing the hostdata in scsih_sdev_init() and scsih_sdev_destroy(). This prevents use-after-free issues that could occur when the event callback runs at interrupt time. The patch also adds a new field to the MPT3SAS_ADAPTER structure to hold this lock.
